stories.title: La justice rejette la demande de réintégration de Philippe Brun, exclu de la primaire socialiste après des accusations de violences, le député saisit la cour d'appel

en.title: French court rejects Philippe Brun's reinstatement request after exclusion from Socialist primary over violence accusations; deputy appeals to appeals court
en.summary: A court rejected Philippe Brun's bid to rejoin the Socialist Party primary after he was excluded following accusations of violence. Brun has indicated he will appeal the decision.

stories.title: Martin Ryan, le Français emprisonné en Azerbaïdjan, a été gracié par le président

en.title: Martin Ryan, French national imprisoned in Azerbaijan, granted pardon by president
en.summary: French citizen Martin Ryan has been pardoned by Azerbaijan's president Ilham Aliyev, appearing on a list of 20 individuals receiving presidential clemency.

stories.title: L'Azerbaïdjan accorde une grâce présidentielle au Français Martin Ryan, emprisonné pour "espionnage"

en.title: Azerbaijan grants presidential pardon to French national Martin Ryan, imprisoned for "espionage"
en.summary: Azerbaijan has pardoned French citizen Martin Ryan, who was imprisoned on espionage charges. Another French businessman, Anass Derraz, remains imprisoned after being sentenced to 12 years for accepting a bribe from a Russian oligarch.

stories.title: Suspendu du PS pour des accusations de violences, Philippe Brun ne pourra réintégrer ni son parti ni la primaire

en.title: Suspended from Socialist Party over violence accusations, Philippe Brun cannot rejoin party or primary
en.summary: Philippe Brun, removed from the Socialist primary over violence allegations, lost his court challenge to the decision on Wednesday. He announced he will appeal the ruling.

stories.title: Azerbaïdjan : grâce présidentielle pour le Français emprisonné Martin Ryan

en.title: Azerbaijan: Presidential pardon for imprisoned Frenchman Martin Ryan
en.summary: A French businessman suspected of espionage and imprisoned since 2023 has received a presidential pardon from Azerbaijan. His release followed EU negotiations regarding sanctions on Russian oligarch Alicher Ousmanov, which France had requested be lifted.

stories.title: Présidentielle 2027 : Philippe Brun ne sera pas réintégré au PS et à la primaire de la gauche, tranche la justice

en.title: 2027 Presidential election: Philippe Brun will not be reinstated to the PS and left primary, rules the court
en.summary: A court ruling denied Philippe Brun's request to rejoin the Socialist Party and participate in the left's primary election after he was excluded over accusations of violence against a former aide.

stories.title: L'Azerbaïdjan gracie le Français Martin Ryan après la levée de sanctions contre un oligarque russe

en.title: Azerbaijan pardons Frenchman Martin Ryan following lifting of sanctions against Russian oligarch
en.summary: Azerbaijan has released French businessman Martin Ryan, age 38, through presidential pardon after he was sentenced to ten years in prison on espionage charges in March amid tensions between Baku and Paris.

stories.title: L’Azerbaïdjan gracie le Français emprisonné Martin Ryan, selon un décret présidentiel

en.title: Azerbaijan pardons imprisoned Frenchman Martin Ryan, according to presidential decree
en.summary: Azerbaijan has pardoned French businessman Martin Ryan through presidential decree. His case reportedly formed part of recent Brussels negotiations where the EU agreed to renew sanctions against approximately 3,000 Russian personalities and entities linked to the war in Ukraine.

stories.title: Présidentielle : la candidate des Écologistes Marine Tondelier a donné naissance à un garçon

en.title: Presidential election: Green Party candidate Marine Tondelier gives birth to a boy
en.summary: Marine Tondelier, the Green Party's presidential candidate, announced the birth of her son Léon. She was the first presidential contender to campaign while pregnant and stated the baby would remain her priority despite the campaign.

stories.title: «Absurdité grotesque» : la colère de Nétanyahou après le discours de soutien à Gaza d’Emmanuel Macron devant l’ONU

en.title: "Grotesque absurdity": Netanyahu's anger after Emmanuel Macron's speech supporting Gaza at the UN
en.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu strongly criticized French President Macron's remarks at the United Nations General Assembly, where Macron expressed dismay at the situation in Gaza. The two leaders disagreed over the characterization of events in the region.

stories.title: Marine Tondelier, candidate des Ecologistes à l’élection présidentielle, annonce avoir donné naissance à son deuxième enfant

en.title: Marine Tondelier, Green Party candidate for the presidential election, announces the birth of her second child
en.summary: Marine Tondelier, officially designated as the Green Party's presidential candidate, gave birth to her second child. She plans to use this occasion to champion reproductive health and child-focused policies.

stories.title: "Un spectacle qui nous fait honte" : Emmanuel Macron critique l'action israélienne en Cisjordanie et à Gaza, l'Etat hébreu dénonce une "absurdité grotesque"

en.title: "A spectacle that shames us": Emmanuel Macron criticizes Israeli action in the West Bank and Gaza, Israel denounces "grotesque absurdity"
en.summary: French President Macron criticized Israeli actions in the West Bank and Gaza during his UN address on Tuesday, noting Hamas's absence from the West Bank territory where the Palestinian Authority operates. Israel responded by rejecting his characterization.

stories.title: « Il n’y a rien pour les salariés » : faute d'avancées lors des négociations, la grève est maintenue chez SFR

en.title: "There is nothing for employees": lacking progress in negotiations, strike is maintained at SFR
en.summary: SFR unions are maintaining a planned strike after Monday negotiations with a buyer consortium yielded no additional concessions. The unions cite insufficient severance pay and unclear employment guarantees as unresolved issues.

stories.title: La Chine s’invite toujours plus dans le marché du géostationnaire

en.title: China increasingly enters the geostationary market
en.summary: Arabsat selected China's CASC to build and launch its Arabsat-50 satellite, marking a significant step for China in expanding its presence in international space markets despite the operator's historical preference for European contractors.

stories.title: Pour l'OCDE, la France décroche alors que l’économie mondiale résiste mieux que prévu

en.title: For the OECD, France falters while global economy resists better than expected
en.summary: The OECD slightly raised its 2026 global growth forecast to 2.9% despite energy shocks from Middle East conflict, but France's economic performance lags behind expectations.

stories.title: Souveraineté : Bercy veut mieux contrôler les engagements pris par les investisseurs étrangers

en.title: Sovereignty: Bercy wants better control of commitments made by foreign investors
en.summary: France's finance ministry plans to systematically verify within five years the commitments made by foreign investors entering the capital of sensitive companies to ensure compliance.

stories.title: Sous pression, le président de l'Ademe met en avant son rôle auprès des collectivités

en.title: Under pressure, the Ademe president highlights his role with local authorities
en.summary: The Ademe president presented the agency's programs for local authorities at a Lille conference, including the "Committed Territory Ecological Transition" initiative and the "Elected Officials for Action" network.
